text: the kettle steam scalded her wrist
drain cleaner splashed on his wrist and its stinging
her shoulders are red and sore after the beach all day
he grabbed the live wire and now his palm is burned
hes sweaty dizzy and cramping after mowing in the heat but talking normally
hes hot as fire confused and stumbling after working in the sun
shes been in the freezing lake shes shivering violently and slurring
just his toes are white waxy and numb from the cold boots
i rolled my ankle its swollen but i can hobble on it
his forearm has a new bend in the middle where there is no joint
her shoulder popped out at the joint it looks square
a bee got me and left its stinger in my arm
i found two tiny fang punctures and the leg is swelling fast after something slithered away
a black widow was on my hand when i felt the pinch
theres a small brown bug burrowed into my skin from hiking
next doors terrier bit clean through her glove
something stung me in the waves long welts across my thigh
she went pale and dropped in church but came round in seconds
he has been out cold for five minutes but breathing
her mouth droops on one side and her words are jumbled
he suddenly dropped and his whole body is jerking rhythmically
shes diabetic skipped lunch and now shes confused and drenched in sweat
a chunk of hotdog went down and he cant make a sound
her chest whistles when she breathes out and her puffer is empty
his face ballooned and hives spread everywhere right after the prawns
the toddlers cough sounds like a seal bark and its worse tonight
shes gulping air fast with tingly fingers after the panic started
the toddler got into the vitamin gummies and ate the whole jar
he finished a whole bottle of vodka and now hes barely rousable
we found him with a syringe pupils like pinheads breathing slow
everyone got headaches and nausea since the heater ran all night
a shallow slice on his thumb from the peeler its oozing a little
the glass went deep into his thigh and blood is pumping out fast
blood keeps dripping from her nostril after she blew her nose
the bandsaw took the top of his finger clean off
the screwdriver is still sticking out of his calf
crushing pressure in his chest spreading to his jaw and hes clammy
my heart is pounding and i feel doom but this always happens before exams
he headed the ball hard and now hes dazed and repeating himself
she fell off the horse and screams if anyone touches her neck
the baby is burning with fever and suddenly started twitching all over
grandpa has epilepsy and this fit looks like his usual ones
boiling soup went all over the toddlers legs
the pool acid tub splashed his shin and the skin is going white
shes wobbly and pale after standing in the hot parade but answers fine
he cant get his wedding ring off his finger is twice the size after the fall onto it
a wasp flew into his mouth and stung his tongue and now his throat feels tight
the dog nipped her calf and it broke the skin slightly
he surfaced coughing hard after being under the water too long
shes eight months pregnant and the contractions are ninety seconds apart
the little one swallowed a coin sized battery from the remote
hes been sick all night and his lips are cracked and dry
i sliced a flap of skin off my knuckle grating cheese
his lower leg is bent sideways under him after the tackle
the cast iron pan seared three of her fingertips
he was defrosting the car all morning and now two fingers are wooden and white
she took her insulin then never ate and now shes slurring
milk went down the wrong way and the baby is silent and going red
his ankle turned over on the curb and puffed up like a golf ball
the old radiator pipe burst and sprayed his forearm with boiling water
